items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 November 2026 11:45am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 24 November 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gale force winds at first. Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure lies to the east of the British Isles, while low pressure to the west of Iceland pushes fronts eastwards across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Southeast 7 or gale 8, gradually becoming cyclonic 4 to 6 by this evening, but 7 in the northeast of the area until early tonight, then becoming east or southeast 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate by early tonight, then slight late tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Occasional rain, heavy and persistent at times, until later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or southeast southeast 4 or 5, becoming south or southeast 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair,


##Visibility##

Good.
